day_shape: 84 items: CENTCOM downs two Iranian attack drones over Strait of Hormuz, IDF reports ~150 Hezbollah sites struck and two soldiers killed in south Lebanon, student protests across ~20 Iranian provinces, heavy Khamenei messaging cycle on Imam Khomeini anniversary, nothing from UK Parliament or OFAC.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz drone interception
threads.summary: US Central Command said American forces shot down two Iranian one-way attack drones threatening international maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz. The Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel carried the CENTCOM statement alongside reporting on parallel US-Iran nuclear consultations.

threads.label: South Lebanon strikes and IDF casualties
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck around 150 Hezbollah infrastructure sites across southern Lebanon over the weekend and announced two soldiers killed in separate incidents, including Cpt. Shahar Gamla, 24. Four reservists were moderately wounded by a Hezbollah FPV drone, two rockets were intercepted, and an Israeli strike near Tebnit/Tabnin killed a Lebanese army general and two soldiers.

threads.label: Iran student protests spread
threads.summary: Iran International, the Jerusalem Post and Times of Israel reported high school student protests in around 20 provinces against final exam rules and university entrance changes, with violence and arrests reported. The reports cited the opposition outlet's tally and noted demonstrations met by security force responses.

threads.label: Khamenei Imam Khomeini anniversary cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a sequence of posts marking the 37th anniversary of Imam Khomeini's passing, including a message asserting that 'the future of the Persian Gulf will be a future without America' and warnings on enemy 'hybrid warfare.' Parliament Speaker Qalibaf echoed themes praising Basij relief work in messages carried by IRIB and Defa Press.

threads.label: Gaza strikes on Hamas commanders
threads.summary: The IDF and Shin Bet said they killed Sakr Abu Karim, a Nukhba cell commander who led the October 7 raid on Kissufim, in a strike on Tuesday. A separate overnight airstrike in southern Gaza killed Hamas cell commander Muhanad Othman Yassin Farwana.

threads.label: Post-war Iran economy and infrastructure
threads.summary: Iran's Deputy Energy Minister said over 7,000 megawatts of power plant capacity were damaged in the 'Ramadan war' with 2,500 megawatts restored, and denied scheduled blackouts pending 10-15% household consumption cuts. The Atomic Energy Organisation head said Bushehr remains operational, and IRIB cited a Bloomberg report on India raising LPG prices a second time due to refinery losses linked to Iran's war.

threads.label: Iran-US diplomacy and sanctions
threads.summary: Iran International reported the Trump administration's sanctions on Iran's largest cryptocurrency exchange, while Times of Israel cited a source saying the US is considering using Iranian funds to help Gulf states rebuild. A parliamentary commission member told Defa Press that any negotiations with Washington are conditional on five Iranian conditions and practical verification.

events.summary_en: Love of the Ahl al-Bayt made 'Mohammad Hossein' celestial. Mohammad Hossein Norouzi, 24 years old, from the traffic police forces of Zanjan, was martyred on 11 Esfand in the bombardment of police station 31 in Kar Employees neighbourhood of Karaj. The vehicle was travelling in an active combat zone that had been evacuated, and a warning was issued of a shooting attack against IDF troops in the area.
events.summary_en: Earlier today (Saturday), the IDF identified a vehicle moving suspiciously towards troops near the village of Tabnin in southern Lebanon. The vehicle was travelling in an active combat zone that had been evacuated, and a warning was issued of a shooting attack against IDF troops in the area. Available information indicates that Hezbollah is operating widely in this area. Following identification of the vehicle and based on intelligence warnings and the threat it posed to the troops, it was targeted. Initial examination results showed that two officers and a soldier from the Lebanese army were inside the vehicle. The incident remains under investigation. It should be noted that an active combat zone requires coordinated movement with the IDF.

events.title: The Lebanese army says a strike carried out by Israel this morning in southern Lebanon killed a senior commander, another officer, and a soldier. The IDF has not yet commented on the strike.
